description: ESP32 IPM driver implementation for Zephyr RTOS, handling inter-processor messaging and interrupt handling.

methods.name: esp32_ipm_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for handling IPM interrupts, clearing flags and invoking callback.

methods.name: esp32_ipm_send
methods.description: Function to send messages via IPM, handling memory locking and interrupt generation.

methods.name: esp32_ipm_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for IPM message reception.

methods.name: esp32_ipm_max_data_size_get
methods.description: Returns maximum data size for IPM messages.

methods.name: esp_32_ipm_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables IPM; always enabled in this implementation.

methods.name: esp32_ipm_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPM device, sets up interrupts and synchronization.
